title: The Bounty Hunter — finished presentation Project (locked final cut)
description: A media-light presentation Project with the screenplay, production planning, floor plan and the locked 55.6-second final cut arranged as 17 picture excerpts. The music soundtrack and voice-over are baked into the film render, as are the opening title cards. Approved film media stays offline until you explicitly choose Download media and relink in Render.
credit: Rights retained by Kyle Brodeur. Screenplay by Bradley Weatherholt. This finished study is provided for evaluation and playback use only, outside the software MIT license.
